title: Teppu
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Natsuo Ishido, a high school first-year who is effortlessly good at every sport, is bored, lonely and openly contemptuous of opponents. After a bloody spar with Yuzuko Mawatari, the untalented but relentless captain of a new mixed martial arts club, she quits volleyball to train in MMA so she can beat her. The story follows her through gym training and a qualifying tournament, where her rivalry with karate captain Sanae brings out her past, including abuse by her older brother.
life_message: Talent alone is empty; a worthy rival, hard training and facing your past give life meaning.

folkways.japan: School club rivalries, captains' authority and the ideal of effort over innate talent (doryoku) reflect Japanese sports-manga norms, described here as context.

winners_losers: Yuzuko's tenacity beats Natsuo's talent, and Natsuo wins a purpose and a rival; Natsuo's arrogance loses. Sympathy goes to effort and to the lonely prodigy learning respect.
